main_text.p: Chaldæis pag 144. Sed profecto nihil liud freqventi9 eccinitur in officio fer quintæ de institutione hujus Sacramei quàm Christum Dominum in Azymis um confecisse corpus.

Animadverte dum tamen, formam seu figuram pai Eucharistici ab aliquibus annis commu ditatis gratia immutatam fuisse & fig ram Latini introductam,unde falso ar trati sunt nonnulli,cum figura immut tam quoque fuisse qualitatem nempe nis fermentati Azymum,quia antiqua nis usualis, & fermentati speciem ferebat. Verba autem illa libri Cons[?] tutionum relata pag.144.notarum:Et accepit tunc ex illo pane azymo, recte op nuntur, Jacobitarum & Nestorianorum verbis,quæ vel in ipso Missæ Canone leguntur : Et accepit ex illo pane fermentato, Hoc de argumento variæ sunt int Orientales controversiæ.
XII. Demum quæris, an pluries in c super idem altare,ut Latinis mos est, m sa c
{h} Nata, multa libris Maronitarum adjectis esse,& plerosque non esse integros.

page.notes: The right edge of the scan cuts off the ends of most lines, so the final letters of many lines are not on the scan. The fragment "sa c" at the right of the line after "m" is the cropped continuation of that line. "Cons[?]": the printed word begins "Con" and the next letter is not clear at the edge. The footnote mark (h) belongs to a word in the cropped part of the text and cannot be placed. "freqventi9": the printed abbreviation sign after "i" is copied as "9" with a doubt. The first line of the footnote is cut at the right edge, so "adjectis" is not certain. Long s is written as plain s throughout. "azymo" carries a mark above the y, which is not copied.
